Built for the Trail, Not the Landfill

Every product on sale is made with the same sourcing standards as our full-price catalog: recycled stainless steel, recycled ripstop nylon, and manufacturing partners we audit annually for fair labor practices. We don't run a separate "budget" product line for sale events. The gear at 25% off this week is identical to the gear you'd pay full price for next month, which is why the lifetime warranty carries over without exception.

That same standard is why this sale only happens once a year instead of running as a rolling discount. Constant markdowns train customers to wait for the next one and quietly push manufacturers toward cheaper materials to protect margin. We'd rather hold the line on quality year-round and offer one meaningful discount when we genuinely have excess stock to clear.
